name: Salix cordata
desc: Heart-leaf willow (Salix cordata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Salix cordata, the sand dune willow, furry willow, or heartleaf willow, is a perennial shrub that grows 3 to 12 feet (0.91 to 3.66 m) tall; plants taller than 6 feet (1.8 m) are rare.
